data.one_liner: Embed Unity 3D games and AR experiences as a Flutter widget on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows embedding a Unity 3D project as a widget within a Flutter app for iOS and Android. Enables bi-directional messaging between Flutter and Unity scripts, supporting Unity 2022.3 and Unity 6 LTS.
use_when: You want to embed a Unity game or 3D scene inside a Flutter application
You need to pass messages back and forth between Flutter and Unity scripts
avoid_when: You need multiple simultaneous instances of Unity running on the same screen
Your app needs to support older Flutter versions or restricted Unity versions
strengths: Brings powerful Unity 3D, AR, and gaming capabilities into Flutter
Supports bi-directional communication between Flutter and Unity
Federated architecture allows extension for different Unity versions
weaknesses: Only supports a single instance of Unity at a time
High memory usage and Unity remains in memory even after the widget is disposed
Strict requirements on Unity versions, Flutter versions, and native Android/iOS settings to avoid crashes
data.setup_notes: Requires specific Unity LTS versions, configuring Android activity configChanges, adding UnityFramework.framework in Xcode for iOS, and matching Gradle/NDK/JDK versions.
